title: Find the Rainbow Colors with Pip! Learn Colors for Toddlers #Shorts
description:
Help Pip the little cloud find all the colors of the rainbow!
Red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple - shout out each color with Pip!
A gentle learning video for toddlers and preschoolers.

#Shorts #LearnColors #Toddlers #Preschool #KidsLearning
character: Pip, a small round fluffy white cloud with big friendly brown eyes, rosy pink cheeks, a tiny happy smile, two little puffy cloud arms, and a soft warm glow around its edges
style: Soft 3D storybook animation, rounded shapes, bright pastel colors, gentle sunny lighting, clean uncluttered background, cheerful calm mood, vertical 9:16 framing. No dialogue, no speech, no on-screen text, no flashing lights. Gentle ambient sound only.

scenes.name: Hook
scenes.prompt: {character} pops into view in the center of a clear blue sky with small puffs of sparkle and waves hello at the camera with one puffy arm. Quick gentle zoom-in on Pip, then hold. {style}

scenes.name: Red
scenes.prompt: {character} floats beside a leafy green apple tree in a sunny garden, looking curiously at one big shiny red apple hanging on a branch. Slow pan from Pip to the apple and back to Pip. {style}

scenes.name: Orange
scenes.prompt: {character} floats over a flower meadow while a bright orange butterfly flutters in a gentle circle around Pip's head. The camera follows the butterfly. {style}

scenes.name: Yellow
scenes.prompt: {character} floats next to a giant smiling yellow sunflower that sways happily in the breeze. Low angle looking up at the tall sunflower, then tilt to Pip. {style}

scenes.name: Green
scenes.prompt: {character} floats above a calm pond where a cute cartoon green frog sits on a lily pad and gives a little hop. Medium shot. {style}

scenes.name: Blue
scenes.prompt: {character} flies through the sky next to a cheerful little bluebird flying alongside. Side-tracking shot moving left to right. {style}

scenes.name: Purple
scenes.prompt: {character} floats over a field of purple lavender flowers gently swaying in the breeze. Slow push-in over the flowers toward Pip. {style}

scenes.name: Payoff
scenes.prompt: {character} cheers with both puffy arms raised as a big complete rainbow of red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple arcs across a bright blue sky behind Pip, with gentle sparkles. Camera pulls back to reveal the full rainbow. {style}

scenes.name: Outro
scenes.prompt: {character} sits happily on top of a rainbow, smiling and waving goodbye at the camera. Slight slow zoom-out. {style}
